author: PicklePenguickle
body:
I am PicklePenguickle and I would like to post an appeal because I feel the need to explain.. I threw a beacon into the void because a player kept trying to steal it from me after I placed it, Not aware that throwing the beacon over the edge was illegal and against the rules as i never see anyone else use the beacons. I was trying to put iron under it and make a speed beacon for my team. (A mod told me i could long ago) So every time I placed it, It would be deleted by the player. I eventually got frustrated that the player was doing that so I decided to just get rid of it.  When I discussed the issue with Acceqted, He was very polite and professional with me but was going to let me off with just a kick. So then I decided to just leave the server because i knew I would be kicked anyway. Also, I was already planning on rejoining after the round was over. (I have to rejoin every couple rounds or my computer will become slow and freezy. So I thought it would just be the perfect chance to do so and receive my kick afterwards if it was still necessary. On my return, I did not have any attitude. I simply said "I kicked myself, lol. But kick me again if u want." I was just trying to lighten the mood while aware of the seriousness of the situation. Acceqted already told me that I shouldn't have thrown it over and it was understood. However, Acceqted took it the wrong way and extended my punishment to a 4 day ban. I am aware that I had a previous team greifing punishment. It was for blocking part of the spawn while I was building something. But i was kicked anyway. I knew that it was alright because my build was partially obstructing the spawn entrance so I immediately took it down on my return.

Thank you for reading and understanding.
-PicklePenguickle

Hey there,

I understand you wish a senior to reply to this appeal. But I am the only one who has knowledge around this situation. Seniors have read over the other appeal and my response and have given me the thumbs up to lock. You will have to wait until your ban expires.

Regards, Josh/Acceqted


I'll leave this open for 24 hours if you have anything to say.
